Life is full of small surprises. Kate's birthday is in July. Last Tuesday, Max and Kate went to the running track. For example, the pig pushed its snout through the wooden fence.
Max usually has noodles for breakfast. Kate is interested in cooking. There are always many people at the dining hall. Also, he refused to apologise, whereupon she left the room.
Max bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Max and Kate had great fun there. Max wrote about the day in the diary. Also, chronic back pain changed his routine.
Max learned a lot about science. It takes twenty minutes to get to the running track by bike. Max hopes to visit Rome one day.
